title: How to keep a sourdough loaf fresh all week
excerpt: A cloth bag, a cut side down and a freezer for the last third. Luca's three rules for bread that lasts.
content:
A good sourdough loaf should last you most of a week. Here's how we keep ours at home.

Keep it out of plastic

Plastic keeps the moisture in and turns the crust soft and the crumb damp. A cotton or linen bag lets it breathe.

Cut side down

Stand the loaf on its cut side on a wooden board. The crust protects the rest of it.

Freeze the last third

By day four, slice what's left and freeze it. Toast it straight from the freezer.

title: Choosing a wedding cake: what to ask your baker
excerpt: Tiers, flavours, tastings and when to book. Everything couples ask us, answered before the first meeting.
content:
We make around forty wedding cakes a year. These are the questions we get most.

How far ahead should we book?

Four weeks is our minimum, but spring and autumn Saturdays fill up three months ahead.

How many tiers do we need?

Three tiers feeds around a hundred people. If you're also having dessert, two will do.

Can we taste first?

Yes. Every wedding cake starts with a tasting of four flavours at the bakery, on a weekday afternoon.

title: Soup season is back
excerpt: From October the soup changes every day. Here's the week's list, and the bread we serve with each one.
content:
The first cold morning means one thing at the counter: soup, every day, until April.

This week

Tomato and red pepper, leek and potato, lentil with lemon, and Friday's French onion with a cheese toast on top.

The bread

Every bowl comes with a slab of the country loaf. Ask for rye instead if you like.

title: Find us at the university on Thursdays
excerpt: Our fourth market stall opens on the lawn by the library, with soup, sandwiches and tart for lunch.
content:
From this term, you'll find us at the University farmers market every Thursday from 11 to 2.

What's on the table

Soup in a cup, sandwiches on the morning's bread, slices of tart and coffee from the van.

For students

Show a student card for 10% off anything on the table.
